title: A Kernel-Checked Exclusion Certificate for Erdős Problem 647
summary: Erdős problem 647 asks whether any $n > 24$ satisfies $\max_{m<n}(m + τ(m)) \le n + 2$, where $τ$ is the divisor-count function. Computational searches have excluded solutions up to $10^{12}$ by direct sieve and up to roughly $9.17 \times 10^{18}$ within a modular reduction whose Lean component relies on native_decide; those computations sit outside any proof kernel. We give the first exclusion checked end to end by one: no solution exists with $24 < n \le 10^9$, proved in Lean 4 with axiom closure exactly {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} -- no sorry, no native_decide, no…
